bodyHtml:
Spindles United FC Joins the Upstate Premier League Ahead of Inaugural Summer Season

Capital Region club becomes a founding member of the new regional competition

COHOES, NY — Spindles United FC has officially announced that the club will compete in the inaugural season of the Upstate Premier League (UPL) this summer, joining fellow Capital Region clubs in a new competition designed to elevate amateur soccer in Upstate New York.

Founded in Cohoes, Spindles United FC has quickly established itself as a competitive and community-driven club in the Capital Region soccer landscape. By joining the Upstate Premier League as a founding member, Spindles United aims to help build a sustainable, high-level platform for amateur players while strengthening local rivalries and expanding opportunities for the region’s soccer community.

Founding Clubs include:

Collar City FC - Troy, NY

Mohawk City FC - Schenectady, NY

Spindles United FC - Cohoes, NY

The league is currently accepting applications to fill the remaining 3 spots to complete the 6-team season.

The Upstate Premier League will launch this summer with a group of founding clubs committed to raising the standard of competition and professionalism in the area. The league’s structure focuses on organized scheduling, club standards, and community engagement while providing a pathway for players and clubs to grow within a regional framework.

“Joining the Upstate Premier League is an exciting step for our club,” said Jarron Frangie of Spindles United FC. “We believe this league will bring a new level of organization and energy to the amateur game in the Capital Region. As a founding club, we’re proud to help shape the future of soccer in Upstate New York.”

Spindles United FC has built a strong identity both on and off the field, with a focus on competitive play, community involvement, and showcasing local talent. The club’s participation in the UPL represents a commitment to helping establish a league that reflects the passion and quality of soccer in the region.

The inaugural Upstate Premier League season will feature multiple Capital Region clubs competing in a home-and-away schedule throughout the summer, creating new rivalries and giving supporters the chance to experience local soccer at a higher level.

Additional announcements regarding schedules, venues, and league details will be released in the coming weeks through the league and participating clubs.

Learn more about the UPL.
